entities.name: The Dalek Asylum
entities.description: A snowy, mountainous planet where Daleks imprison malfunctioning or insane Daleks, protected by a force field and nanocloud.

entities.name: Daleks
entities.description: A race who use the Asylum as a prison and dumping ground.

relations.note: The Daleks use the planet as a prison.
relations.quote: used by the Daleks as a prison and "dumping ground"
